title: Add source install upgrade preflight
summary: The source alpha installer can be validated, but operators need a read-only upgrade preflight that detects existing installs, manifest drift, and rollback blockers before any package-manager distribution claim is made.
expectedFailureModes: Operators overwrite an existing source install without seeing manifest drift or binary replacement scope first.
Distribution readiness implies upgrade safety even though rollback mutation and signing policy are not implemented.
The preflight records machine-local absolute paths in committed docs or validation fixtures.
nextAction: Add a source install upgrade preflight report and validator, then update distribution docs/status to mark automatic rollback as still blocked while source upgrade inspection is implemented.
